notes.title: A tribute to classic 90s games and comic books, the RPG adventure Heroes of the Seven Islands is out now
notes.notes:
Heroes of the Seven Islands is an intentionally badly drawn challenging tribute to classic role-playing video games and comic books.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/09/a-tribute-to-classic-90s-games-and-comic-books-the-rpg-adventure-heroes-of-the-seven-islands-is-out-now/

notes.title: Heroes of the Seven Islands is OUT NOW
notes.notes: [p][b]After two years of development, Heroes of the Seven Islands, the cRPG that I drew by hand on paper, is released on Steam. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]In 2023, I started developing this game which is a tribute to classic role-playing games and franco-belgian comics. It was also an opportunity for me to learn how to draw using pencil and paper. It’s a solo dev experience, I tried to do all aspects of the game: programming, drawing, writing and so on.[/p][p][/p][p]As of today, the game contains 267 backgrounds and 789 sprites, drawn on hundreds of sheets of paper stacked next to my desk. For the soundtrack, I had the opportunity to work with Eric Shumaker (composer of Look Outside), iorekb and Castlewalker, to make 36 unique tracks.[/p][p][/p][p]I am glad to have been able to exchange ideas with so many people during the game's development. Their feedback helped me transform a somewhat clumsy game into a fantasy adventure that I am proud of today, and which I still enjoy playing (just paused the game to write this).[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you will enjoy Heroes of the Seven Islands, and can’t wait to have your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/76c0be99b86e3e7a22b8a81b6550702f5d4d849e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/c04b123183f3dff63cb80e565450ba43e0cd3fe5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/488848f8f5ac61b868752e7f0fcd6334e85a9bce.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/e1590e0c2a19b98e1065b78f3e60128974493cc7.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Release Date + Tiny Teams
notes.notes: [h3]Coming [b]SEPTEMBER 9th, 2025[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We're thrilled to announce that [b]Heroes of the Seven Islands[/b] officially has a release date![/p][p]The game is expected to take players roughly [u]10-15 hours[/u] on their first playthrough. It will be listed for [u]$11.99 USD[/u] with a planned launch discount.[/p][previewyoutube="4Skrsq2USqg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Check out this brand new trailer made to celebrate the occasion, featuring an all new theme for the game composed by the incredibly talented Eric Shumaker ([i]Look Outside[/i]).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096725/fc903b31bc6f5c343f5d8f95d23b6c4a9db8c5ff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We are also incredibly excited to have [b]Heroes of the Seven Islands [/b]selected to take part in the [u]Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival 2025[/u]! This event is dedicated to small indie game teams. Be sure to check it out to support other solo/small teams and their delightful games![/p][p]Be sure to add Heroes of the Seven Islands to your Wishlist. You can try the free demo NOW. And be sure to leave us a review so we can polish the game leading up to the release next month![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346810/Heroes_of_the_Seven_Islands_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Scribbly comic-book styled Heroes of the Seven Islands is a party-based RPG inspired by 90s games
notes.notes:
With a demo now available, if you love turn-based dungeon crawling RPGs like something out of the 90s, be sure to go and check out Heroes of the Seven Islands.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/01/scribbly-comic-book-styled-heroes-of-the-seven-islands-is-a-party-based-rpg-inspired-by-90s-games/
